# Vendored: tree-sitter-blade

- Upstream: https://github.com/EmranMR/tree-sitter-blade (MIT, 264 stars, active)
- Commit: `b5291d1ba207a8ebb8383b2ecb8a8a6535210a50` (main, 2026-08-31, "Merge pull request #130 from django23/feat/conditional-attributes"); upstream Cargo.toml version 0.12.0.
- Not published on crates.io (the names `tree-sitter-blade*` return 404 there), and `cargo deny` bans git dependencies, so the generated parser is vendored.
- `src/parser.c` (23 MB, generated by tree-sitter 0.25.x, ABI 15) sha256 `a04483803c19742cb82bddf8c055d1ff2e12168ef0f5c1e4af33064d804a5286`; `src/scanner.c`, `src/tag.h`, `src/tree_sitter/*.h` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged.
- Ours: `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, `lib.rs` (upstream's `bindings/rust` minus its dev-dependency on `tree-sitter`, which would pull a second `tree-sitter` into the lockfile).
- Refresh: download the tarball of a newer commit, copy the same files, update this note, re-run `cargo nextest run -p sg-analysis`.
- Size note: the parser is large because the grammar embeds HTML. If the repository size matters more than a tree-sitter parse of Blade, set `blade.maintained` to `false` in `rules/grammar-tiers.json` and remove this directory; the regex sinks in the same file take over.
